title: shake
description: Screen shake on the source footage, with an optional motion-blur smear ramp.

intensity.description: Shake amplitude. 0.3 is a nudge, 0.8 is a full hit.

decay.description: How fast the shake dies. 0 keeps shaking, 1 is a snap.

motion_blur.description: Smear strength from a lagged ghost layer. 0 disables the extra layer.

rotation.description: Degrees of rotation kick at full intensity.
